in_marathi.name: Havish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Sacrifice
in_marathi.long_meaning: Havish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Havish is the name of the deity Agni, who is considered the lord of fire and the god of sacrifice. He plays an essential role in the Vedic rituals and is invoked during various religious ceremonies.

vedic_reference.note: Havish is derived from the Sanskrit word 'हविष्' (haviṣ), which is used to describe a bow or a weapon used in rituals. In Hindu mythology, Lord Rama is depicted carrying a bow, and the name Havish could be considered a tribute to this iconic image.
